messages:
ana: FYI i found a subtle hang when cancelling async streaming in the python SDK sample app. reproducible with uvloop + aiohttp.
ana: repro gist incoming, short test that starts stream, reads one chunk, then cancels the task.
ben: does the server send a 401 or refresh mid-stream? we've seen token refresh races before.
ana: yes, the repro fastapi server responds with a 401 on a keepalive probe and our auth middleware triggers refresh. sequence seems to be: open stream -> read first chunk -> keepalive 401 -> auth refresh -> caller cancels task -> socket stays ESTABLISHED, no finalizer logs.
jon: interesting. is the SDK holding any locks during refresh? if the refresh happens in the same event loop, cancel might interrupt before cleanup.
nana: i printed stacktraces: the read coroutine is waiting in resp.content.readchunk() and never returns after cancel. adding a try/finally in user test doesn't always run because the cancel races before entering.
ciara: quick workaround in app: use a shielded cleanup task that awaits cancellation and does resp.close(), but that complicates onboarding sample.
ben: could we adjust the SDK to proactively close the transport on cancellation? e.g., attach a done callback to the task and call resp.close().
nana: that might help; also worth documenting. right now the onboarding sample is minimal and this behavior is confusing to new users.
jon: filing an issue and assigning eng-runtime. include the small repro and system netstat output (shows ESTABLISHED) + uvloop version.
ci-bot: created issue #1962: "python-stream-cancel-hang-token-refresh" and added label "devex:repro".
ciara: devex plan: update sample to show recommended cancellation pattern (explicit resp.close() in a cancellation handler + per-request read timeout) and a troubleshooting note about token refresh interactions. also add a tiny unit test that cancels mid-stream so we don't regress.
ben: engineering note: runtime should investigate whether auth refresh can acquire a lock that prevents stream cleanup; if so consider making refresh lock-free for streaming requests or queue refresh outside stream read path.
nana: i'll send a PR for the sample and tests, will include the workaround and link to the issue.
ciara: thanks, please ping once the PR is up and i'll add a short blurb to the onboarding guide. :thumbsup:
